why: Gives the shipped death ring the held attack of the `opposed` arm that issue #1120 removed: full brightness for the first 18% of its life before it fades. The ruling on #718 kept the shipped pulse over that arm, so a death ring that holds is the rejected arm coming back one envelope at a time. The ring still appears, still fades out and still recycles on the same frame, so only its brightness early in life tells the builds apart.
killedBy: death pulse: the shipped shockwave (issue #1120 keeps it) travels evenly and fades from its first frame, rather than holding and blasting
